original: あれっ。\nもしかして\nスパーダって二刀流なのか？
traducao: Huh?\nCould it be you're a dual wielder,\nSpada?

original: あぁ？
traducao: Hah?

original: そうだけど……。\nそれがどうしたってェんだ？
traducao: Yeah, so what......?\nWhat's it to ya?

original: そうかそうか〜！\nいや、実は俺も二刀流なんだ
traducao: I see, I see~!\nTruth is, I'm a dual wielder too!

original: やっぱいいよな、二刀って！
traducao: Dual wielding really is the best!

original: なんだ、お前もなのか
traducao: Oh, so you're one too, huh?

original: バカっぽい顔してる割に、\nいいセレクトじゃねえか
traducao: For someone with an idiot face,\nthat's a pretty sweet choice.

original: 何といっても、二刀の魅力は\n手数の多さだよなぁ
traducao: Above all, the beauty of two swords\nis the sheer number of hits, right?

original: それでいて、強さの真髄は\nごくシンプルなのもいい
traducao: And the core of its strength\nis so purely simple too!

original: そうそう。\nなかなかわかって……
traducao: Right, right.\nYou actually get it......

original: 剣が二本で二倍強い！\nこんなシンプルな強さは\n他にないよなー！
traducao: Two swords make you twice as strong!\nThere's no other kind of strength\nas simple as that!

original: ……やっぱ、ただのバカか
traducao: ......Never mind, you're just an idiot.

original: なに〜？　\nスパーダってばどうしたの？\nさっきからロックスの事、じ〜っと見て
traducao: What's up?\nWhat's the matter, Spada?\nStaring at Rocks this whole time...

original: あぁ？\n別に、何でもねーよ
traducao: Hah?\nIt's nothin', alright.

original: スパーダお坊ちゃまは\nご実家に残された執事の事を\n思い出してらっしゃるんですのよね？
traducao: Master Spada is remembering\nthe butler back at his family estate,\nisn't that right?

original: 執事？
traducao: A butler?

original: ……って、はわ〜！？
traducao: ......Wait, hawaaa?!

original: もしかして、スパーダってば\nお金持ちだったの！？
traducao: Could it be you're actually\nfilthy rich, Spada?!

original: お金持ちも何も、武門の名家の御曹司。\n生粋のボンボンよ！
traducao: Rich? Scion of a noble martial house!\nA bonafide spoiled rich boy!

original: だから、ロックスを見てると\n色々思い出しちゃって、ナーバスに\nなっちゃうのよねぇ？　グシシシシシ
traducao: So seeing Rocks makes you remember\nall that and gets you nervous,\ndoesn't it? Gushishishi!

original: おいテメ、イリア！
traducao: Hey, damn you, Iria!

original: オホホホホホホ！
traducao: Ohohohohoho!

original: スパーダ……本当にお坊ちゃまだったんだ。\nという事は……
traducao: Spada... You really were a rich boy.\nWhich means......

original: アニスちゃんの王子様かも〜∀\n待って下さい、スパーダ様ぁ∀∀
traducao: You might be Anise's prince~!\nWait for me, Lord Spada~~!

original: ふう、ふう……
traducao: Phew, pant......

original: （はぁ……手がちぎれそうです。\n　さすがに、一度にこの量を運ぶのは\n　ちょっと無理があったかなぁ……）
traducao: (Haaah... My arms feel like tearing off.\nCarrying this much at once was a bit\ntoo much, wasn't it...?)

original: （でも、しっかり勤めを果たさないと……！）
traducao: (Still, I must do my duties properly...!)

original: おい、貸せよ。\nこっち持ってやる
traducao: Hey, hand it over.\nI'll take this one.

original: いえ、でも……。\nこれが僕の仕事ですので
traducao: No, but......\nThis is my job, after all.

original: いーから貸せっつってんだよ！
traducao: I said give it here, already!

original: ったくよぉ、ンなちっこい体で\nこんな荷物運べるわけねーだろが
traducao: Good grief, no way your tiny body\ncan carry luggage like this!

original: オラ、行くぞ。\nちゃっちゃと運んじまおーぜ！
traducao: Come on, let's move.\nLet's get this hauled in a flash!

original: え？　\nあ……はい
traducao: Eh?\nAh...... yes!

original: ありがとうございます。\nスパーダ様は、優しいんですね
traducao: Thank you very much.\nYou are so kind, Lord Spada.

original: バーカ！\n寒ィ事言ってんじゃねーよ！！
traducao: Idiot!\nDon't say such cheesy crap!!

original: 当たり前の事してるだけだってェの。\n勝手に深読みしてんじゃねーよ！
traducao: I'm just doing what's obvious!\nDon't go overthinking it!

original: そういうのを、優しいというのだと\n思いますけどね。\nふふ…
traducao: I believe that is precisely\nwhat kindness is, though.\nFufu...

original: よいしょ、よいしょ……
traducao: Heave, ho......

original: うわぁ〜、重そうだなぁ
traducao: Whoa~ Looks really heavy!

original: 半分手伝うよ。\nそっちの大きいやつ、貸してくれ
traducao: I'll help you with half.\nGive me that big one over there.

original: いえ、でも……。\nこれが僕の仕事ですので
traducao: No, but......\nThis is my job, after all.

original: いーからいーから
traducao: Don't worry about it!

original: ドワーフの誓い、第２番。\n困ってる人を見かけたら\n必ず力を貸そう、だ
traducao: Dwarven Vow number 2:\nIf you see someone in trouble,\nalways lend a hand!

original: ほら、早く行こうぜ。\nこれはどこに運んどけばいいんだ？
traducao: Come on, let's hurry up.\nWhere should I carry this to?

original: ……じゃあ、お言葉に甘えて
traducao: ......Then, I'll take you up on that.

original: その荷物は、食料庫までお願い出来ますか
traducao: Could you take that load to the pantry?

original: おう、任しとけ！
traducao: Yeah, leave it to me!

original: あっ、そっちは卵が入ってるんです。\nあまり振らない様にお願い出来ますか……
traducao: Ah, there are eggs in that one.\nPlease try not to shake it much......

original: ふ〜ん。\n何だよ、ロイドの奴……
traducao: Hmph.\nLook at that Lloyd guy......

original: いい奴じゃねーか
traducao: He's a pretty good guy, ain't he?

original: しっかし、ロックスってマメよねぇ〜。\nカノンノの世話焼き魔人って感じ
traducao: Still, Rocks is so diligent~\nLike a fiend devoted to Kanonno's care.

original: 生涯、お嬢様に忠義を尽くし\nお傍で奉公させていただくのが\n僕の一番の喜びですから
traducao: Serving with loyalty at milady's side\nfor the rest of my days\nis my greatest joy, after all.

original: 忠義ねェ。\n立派なモンだが
traducao: Loyalty, huh?\nAdmirable and all, but...

original: ま、オレには単なるパシリにしか\n見えねえけどな
traducao: Well, to me it just looks\nlike being a plain errand boy.

original: パ、パシリとは失礼な！\n僕はそんなんじゃ……
traducao: A-An errand boy?! How rude!\nI'm not doing anything like......

original: オラ、つまみが足んねーぞ！\n何チンタラしてんだコラァ！！
traducao: Hey, we're outta snacks here!\nStop dragging your feet, damn it!!

original: ヒィッ！\nす、すみません今すぐに〜〜！！
traducao: Eeeek!\nI-I'm so sorry, right away~~!!

original: ホラな。\nありゃ、完全に条件反射だ
traducao: See that?\nThat was a conditioned reflex.

original: 相当な下積み経験があると見たぜ
traducao: I bet he's done tons of grunt work.

original: あんたの嗅覚も大したもんだわ……
traducao: Your nose for that is pretty sharp too...

original: なぁ、ヒトの進化種って\nどんなのがいると思う？
traducao: Hey, what kind of evolved humans\ndo you think are out there?

original: ……どういう意味だ
traducao: ......What do you mean?

original: 例えば、ほら\n種の存続の為にだな……
traducao: Like, say,\nfor the survival of the species...

original: 狙ってる女の好みのタイプが\n見破れる進化種とか、\nスリーサイズがわかっちまう進化種とか
traducao: An evolved type who sees a girl's type,\nor one who can tell her measurements\nat a glance!

original: だってよォ、ただでさえ\n出会いが少ない世の中だぜ？
traducao: Come on, meetings are rare enough\nin this world as it is, right?

original: そン中から、カップルになれる確率なんて\nそれこそ……
traducao: The chances of becoming a couple\nfrom that are basically......

original: っておい、無視かよっ！？
traducao: Hey, you're ignoring me?!

original: 今のはツッコむところだろーが！
traducao: That was your cue to call me out!

original: 待っていろ、クレア……。\n今助けに行く！
traducao: Wait for me, Claire......\nI'm coming to save you now!

original: オイ！　\n落ち着けって！！
traducao: Hey!\nCalm down, damn it!!

original: 痛ッ……何をする！！\nその手を離せ！！
traducao: Ow... What are you doing?!\nLet go of me!!

original: （やべェ！　咄嗟に髪の毛掴んじまった！\n　こいつの髪、何でこんな長ェんだよ！？）
traducao: (Crap! I grabbed his hair on reflex!\nWhy the hell is it so damn long?!)

original: こうでもしなきゃ、お前は\nオレの話なんか聞かなかったろーが
traducao: If I didn't, you wouldn't have\nlistened to a word I said, would ya?!

original: ったく……一人で暴走してんじゃねえ！\nお前がそんなで、確実にクレアを\n助け出す事なんて出来ンのか？
traducao: Jeez... Don't go running off alone!\nActing like that, do you really think\nyou can save Claire for sure?!

original: ちったァ、頭冷やせ！
traducao: Cool your head down a bit!

original: ……そう、だな……。\nスパーダの言う通りだ
traducao: ......You're right......\nIt's just as you say, Spada.

original: すまなかった
traducao: I am sorry.

original: おう。\nわかりゃあいいんだよ
traducao: Yeah.\nAs long as you get it, it's cool.

original: （危ねェ危ねェ……。\n　何とかそれっぽく誤魔化せたぜ〜）
traducao: (Close one, that was close...\nManaged to bluff my way through~)

original: なあ、スパーダ。\n話があるんだけど
traducao: Hey, Spada.\nThere's something I want to discuss.

original: あァ？　\n何だよ
traducao: Hah?\nWhat is it?

original: スパーダの武器についてなんだけど、\nもっと色んな二刀流を試してみても\nいいんじゃないかな
traducao: It's about your weapons, Spada.\nWhy don't you try out all kinds\nof different dual wielding styles?

original: 色んな二刀流だぁ？
traducao: Different dual wielding styles?!

original: そう。\n例えば短剣と弓矢とか！
traducao: Yeah!\nLike a dagger and a bow and arrow!

original: 短剣持ってたら、\n弓に矢がつがえらんねェだろ
traducao: If you're holding a dagger, you can't\nnock an arrow to a bow, moron!

original: あ、そうか
traducao: Ah, good point.

original: じゃあ、短剣を相手に投げて\nその隙に矢を射るとか！
traducao: Then throw the dagger at the foe\nand shoot an arrow in the opening!

original: 二刀流の意味ねェよ！\nってか、刀ですらねえし！！
traducao: Zero point in dual wielding then!\nAnd a bow ain't even a blade!!

original: う〜ん、じゃあ\n長剣とステッキとか……？
traducao: Hmm, then how about\na longsword and a cane......?

original: 結局何が言いたいんだ、お前はよ……。\n人をおちょくってンのか？　\nああ？
traducao: What're you even trying to say?!\nAre you mocking me?!\nHuh?!

original: （うーん、なかなか難しいんだな。\n　二刀流って……）
traducao: (Hmm, dual wielding really is\nquite difficult, isn't it......)

traducao: Normal.\n

traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.
